metadata.policy: Only records enumerated by the two independently reviewed Task 8 mapping reports may use report-derived ownership; every other product requirement must validate its exact ledger evidence.

exactSlices.source: Task 8 independently reviewed core and UI slice maps

capabilityDedupe.method: Deduplicate only when report and ledger slices share a tracked product/test path boundary and their stated behavior is the same capability. Broad files such as dispatch.rs, TimelineContainer.tsx or Preview.tsx are not sufficient without semantic agreement. Products/tests are exact-object unions; record IDs retain their source prefix and are never coalesced.
